name: trade.onestop/onestop-mcp
title: onestop
description: Gasless Solana swaps, market-cap limit, trailing and TWAP orders, and plans. Your key stays local.

environmentVariables.name: ONESTOP_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The private key of the wallet that trades, as your wallet exports it. Use a wallet you keep for trading

environmentVariables.name: ONESTOP_KEYPAIR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Or the path to a keypair file, instead of the private key

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your RPC, used to simulate every transaction before signing (default: public mainnet)

environmentVariables.name: ONESTOP_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: true to trade nothing: order tools answer without calling onestop and swaps stop after the guard
